mapper.select: /*selectSellerMdCtPrivateInfoAlterPopList*/ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME_LOC, A.USER_NAME_ENG, A.USER_NAME_ENG, A.LANG, A.USER_TYPE, NVL(A.MAIL_RECV_FLAG,'N') AS MAIL_RECV_FLAG, A.EMAIL, A.ZIP_CODE, A.MOBILE_PHONE, A.ADDRESS_LOC, A.ADDRESS_ENG, A.PHONE_NUMBER, A.FAX_NUMBER, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY, A.ZIP_KEY, NVL(A.ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC2, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.COUNTRY) AS COUNTRY_TEXT, NVL( (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M004' AND CODE = A.CITY), (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.CITY) ) AS CITY_TEXT, B.COM_CODE, B.COM_NAME_LOC, B.IRS_NO, A.DEPARTMENT, A.POSITION, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.DEPARTMENT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) DEPARTMENT_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C003' AND CODE = A.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) POSITION_TEXT FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE UPPER(A.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{st_user_id}) AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET USER_NAME_LOC = #{st_user_name_loc}, USER_NAME_ENG = #{st_user_name_eng}, LANG = #{st_lang}, EMAIL = #{st_email}, USER_TYPE = #{change_user_type}, CHANGE_USER_TYPE = #{change_user_type}, COUNTRY = #{st_country}, CITY = #{st_city}, ZIP_CODE = #{st_zip_code}, ADDRESS_LOC = #{st_address} || ' ' || #{st_address_dt}, ZIP_KEY = #{st_zip_key}, ADDRESS_LOC1 = #{st_address}, ADDRESS_LOC2 = #{st_address_dt}, MOBILE_PHONE = #{st_mobile_phone}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{st_phone_number}, FAX_NUMBER = #{st_fax_number}, MAIL_RECV_FLAG = #{st_mail_recv_flag}, DEPARTMENT = #{st_department}, POSITION = #{st_position}, STATUS = 'S' WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}
